title: The Word on the Other Seat (proposed)

story.text:
# 📄 The Word on the Other Seat (proposed)
**document** · shared · narrative

PROPOSED, unbound. The lending of the harness seats to other models: the blade the code holds, the judgement that split, the charm and the seal that was not earned. A name is the hand you reach for the thing with.
> *A name is not the thing. It is the hand you reach for the thing with.*
